name: Attunement

soc2_evidence.signal: HIPAA Compliant listed as a key feature on homepage; built for behavioral health compliance but no SOC 2 mentioned
Connects to EHRs via FHIR/HL7, stores clinical data — regulated environment requiring SOC 2 for enterprise sales
YC-only seed $500K raised April 2024; no SOC 2 page found at attunement.ai/security (404)

hiring_signals: No current job postings on YC platform
Previously posted Founding Engineer role (now filled); team size 3
pitch_note: Attunement sells compliance automation to behavioral health orgs — a highly regulated sector where their enterprise buyers will demand SOC 2 before signing. No SOC 2 evidence found on their site; HIPAA compliance is mentioned but that is a floor, not a ceiling for enterprise procurement. With a 3-person team and fresh YC seed funding, they are exactly at the stage where SOC 2 Type I would unblock deals.

name: InQuery

soc2_evidence.signal: InQuery maintains SOC 2 Type I attestation from a qualified third-party auditor and is actively progressing toward SOC 2 Type II
Uses AWS KMS for AES-256 encryption at rest; HIPAA-compliant BAA; 130 security controls documented

hiring_signals: No current job postings on YC platform; team size 4
aws_evidence: AWS KMS used for encryption key management; stated on inquery.ai/security
pitch_note: InQuery already holds SOC 2 Type I and is progressing toward Type II — they are mid-journey and could benefit from attestation services to accelerate the Type II audit. They are AWS-native and serve law firms handling PHI, a strong regulated-buyer signal. However they are partially disqualified from a cold-start pitch; best angle is Type II acceleration or gap assessment.

name: Parallel

soc2_evidence.signal: Website states data hosted in EU, compliant with RGPD, HDS (French health data hosting), and ISO 27001; no SOC 2 mentioned
Security page (beparallel.com/security) returned 404; no SOC 2 trust page found
Deploys in European hospitals; ISO 27001 and HDS focus suggests EU compliance path, SOC 2 likely not yet pursued for US market

hiring_signals: No current job postings on YC platform; team size 15
Raised $20M Series A in March 2026 from Index Ventures — likely expanding US operations soon
aws_evidence: No AWS mention found; EU-hosted infrastructure per website
pitch_note: Parallel is France-based selling to European hospitals under ISO 27001 / HDS. SOC 2 is not their current compliance path. However, their fresh $20M raise and likely US expansion ambitions could make SOC 2 Type I a near-term need as US hospital systems demand it. A forward-looking pitch around US market entry compliance readiness may resonate.

name: Cleva

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 mentioned on website or in any press coverage; compliance posture focused on FinCEN MSB registration, IMTO license (Nigeria CBN), and Flagright AML
Regulated fintech handling USD accounts and international money transfers for businesses — US enterprise and B2B clients will require SOC 2

hiring_signals: No current job postings on YC platform; team size 30
CTO Philip Abel is an AWS infrastructure veteran — likely building on AWS
aws_evidence: CTO Philip Abel previously spent years as an infrastructure engineer at AWS building multi-region services per YC profile
pitch_note: Cleva is a regulated fintech handling US dollar accounts for African businesses — their US-based financial partners and enterprise B2B clients will increasingly require SOC 2 attestation. With an AWS-native CTO background, infrastructure-first culture, and no SOC 2 evidence found, they are a strong candidate approaching the scale where enterprise deals get blocked without it.

name: Velorum Therapeutics

soc2_evidence.signal: Drug discovery / therapeutics company, not a SaaS or data platform; SOC 2 is not standard compliance for pharma R&D companies
No SOC 2 or trust page found; company focuses on cancer drug development, not software/data services

hiring_signals: No current job postings on YC platform; team size 5
pitch_note: Velorum Therapeutics is a drug discovery company, not a SaaS or data services provider. SOC 2 is not the relevant compliance framework for pharma R&D; they would pursue FDA, GxP, or similar regulatory paths. Wrong ICP — do not pursue.

name: xPay

soc2_evidence.signal: Website claims PCI DSS compliance only; no SOC 2 mentioned anywhere on site or in docs
FAQ page (docs.xpaycheckout.com/faqs) found but no SOC 2 reference; compliance focus is on RBI/FEMA and PCI DSS
Sells billing infrastructure to global SaaS companies — enterprise SaaS buyers universally require SOC 2 from payment/billing vendors

hiring_signals: Founding Sales Lead role posted on YC (Bengaluru); actively hiring go-to-market
Team size 3; early-stage, infrastructure and compliance build-out likely next priority
pitch_note: xPay provides billing infrastructure to global SaaS companies — a segment where SOC 2 is a table-stakes requirement demanded by enterprise SaaS clients. Currently only PCI DSS compliant. As they pursue larger B2B SaaS customers, SOC 2 Type I will be the first gate. Small team, hiring sales, early-stage — perfect timing for SOC 2 initiation conversation.

name: Powder

soc2_evidence.signal: Website explicitly states SOC 2 Type I and SOC 2 Type II completed with continued monitoring
Listed as serving largest and most regulated global institutions with SEC/FINRA compliance built in

hiring_signals: Founding Software Engineer, Agents role posted ($100K-$150K, 0.30%-1.00% equity, Redwood City CA)
pitch_note: Powder has completed both SOC 2 Type I and Type II — fully disqualified as a new SOC 2 services lead. They are already compliant and serving regulated financial institutions. Do not pursue.

name: Piramidal

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 mention on website, YC page, or in press coverage; no trust/security page found (404)
Healthcare AI company processing EEG/brainwave data for neurologists and epilepsy diagnosis; hospital and clinical buyers will require SOC 2 + HIPAA
Advisory team from Cleveland Clinic, Stanford, King's College London — institutional healthcare buyers with strict vendor compliance requirements

hiring_signals: Front End Engineer - User Interface ($120K-$235K, New York)
Team size 10; actively hiring technical talent post-$6M seed raise
pitch_note: Piramidal is a well-funded ($6M seed) healthcare AI company selling EEG diagnostic tools to neurologists and hospital systems. Clinical and hospital buyers are among the strictest enterprise procurement environments — SOC 2 Type I will be required before meaningful enterprise contracts close. They are actively hiring, recently funded, and have no visible compliance certifications. Highest-priority lead in this slice.
